articles.title: Tyreek Hill's agent warns the NFL and the Chiefs: “I think he's going to make a big comeback”
articles.standfirst: Hill is still a free agent as he aims to return from his knee injury
articles.summary: Hill is still a free agent as he aims to return from his knee injury
articles.body:
T yreek Hill remains a free agent as he works towards a return from a serious knee injury, but his representative believes the wide receiver is getting closer to receiving medical clearance and resuming his NFL career as agent Drew Rosenhaus offered an encouraging update on the former Kansas City Chiefs star.

Making an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show on Tuesday, Rosenhaus explained that he continues to contact teams about the possibility of signing Hill once he is cleared to play as he looks to work his way back from the injury sustained whilst playing for the Miami Dolphins in the 2025 season.

"Right now, I'm still working the phones for Tyreek Hill," Rosenhaus said. "And as soon as Tyreek is healthy and is cleared medically, I'm letting teams know, 'Hey, remember, you may not have to trade for a receiver. You could just go sign Tyreek whenever we get that medical clearance.'

"Which we hope will be soon. And at the end of the day, I think Tyreek is close, as we're looking at him right now. I think he's going to make a great comeback.

"I do think he's close to getting cleared. He hasn't been cleared yet, but when we get that okay, I expect him to be playing and making things happen this season."

Have the Chiefs moved on from Tyreek Hill?

Hill has not featured since suffering that devastating knee injury against the New York Jets mere weeks into the season, leaving his immediate future uncertain as he works through rehabilitation as the 32-year-old cannot return until he receives the necessary medical approval.

Rosenhaus suggested that the timeline could extend into the coming weeks, stressing that he has not attempted to rush his client's recovery given the seriousness of the injury, and fortunately the closure of the NFL ’s trade deadline on November 10 will not impact him.

"I do think it's within the next few weeks,” Rosenhaus said. “And I've never pressured Tyreek because it's a tough injury that he had. And look, we're still waiting for guys like (Packers OLB) Micah Parsons to come back, and to put things in comparison, you know, Tyreek, he had a tough injury, and he's still on course, but it is going to be a few weeks."

Kansas City is an obvious potential destination given Hill 's previous success with the franchise and his familiarity with head coach Andy Reid 's system - however, the Chiefs have already addressed their receiver needs by acquiring Josh Downs from the Indianapolis Colts ahead of the trade deadline.

The deal saw Kansas City surrender 2027 fourth and fifth-round picks in exchange for Downs and a seventh-round selection, picking up the 25-year-old who has recorded 33 receptions for 354 yards and one touchdown through nine games this season, giving Patrick Mahomes another option in the passing game.

The Chiefs had initially explored a move for the Jacksonville Jaguars ' receiver Brian Thomas Jr. , but those efforts were unsuccessful whilst Hill was considered another possibility, although his lack of medical clearance complicated any potential agreement prompting general manager Brett Veach to make a move elsewhere.

Downs ' arrival could therefore reduce the urgency for Kansas City to pursue another receiver, particularly with Hill 's availability still uncertain as although the former Chiefs wideout would bring a different dimension to the offense, his recovery must come first – and there is no guarantee he will be the star he was from 2016-2023.

articles.title: Travis Kelce gets a spark as Chiefs pull the trigger on savvy trade for Josh Downs
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs have added another weapon to Patrick Mahomes' offense, and Travis Kelce is already excited about what the move could bring to Kansas City
articles.summary: The Chiefs have added another weapon to Patrick Mahomes' offense, and Travis Kelce is already excited about what the move could bring to Kansas City
articles.body:
T he Kansas City Chiefs made a significant move ahead of the NFL trade deadline, acquiring wide receiver Josh Downs from the Indianapolis Colts. The deal addresses a position that needed reinforcement as injuries and inconsistent production have limited the team's options throughout the season.

Kelce learned about the acquisition during the latest episode of the New Heights podcast, where his brother Jason brought up the news. The veteran tight end did not hide his enthusiasm, pointing to the possibilities that Downs could bring to Andy Reid's offense.

Kelce explains why Josh Downs could be a valuable addition

Kelce believes Downs gives Kansas City another reliable option, particularly when opposing defenses turn to man coverage. He highlighted the receiver's ability to create separation and find openings against zone defenses, qualities that could become important in tight games.

The Chiefs star also welcomed the opportunity to have another fast player on the field, explaining that an additional offensive threat would force defenses to account for more options. Kelce made it clear that he is looking forward to getting Downs into the building and helping him adjust to the team's system.

Josh Downs gives Patrick Mahomes another option

Downs arrives in Kansas City after a difficult stretch with Indianapolis, where the Colts struggled to find consistency on offense . The 25-year-old had recorded 33 receptions for 354 yards and one touchdown through nine games this season, and will now have the opportunity to catch passes from Mahomes.

The Chiefs sent Indianapolis 2027 fourth- and fifth-round draft picks in exchange for Downs and a seventh-round selection. The move could give Kansas City an important boost as it looks to strengthen its offense for the remainder of the campaign, while also taking some defensive attention away from Kelce.

Kelce's reaction to the trade showed just how much he welcomes the addition. With Downs now joining the Chiefs, Kansas City has another receiver who could help open up opportunities for the rest of its offensive weapons.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes impersonator fools everyone with his spot on impression of the Chiefs QB
articles.standfirst: His unusual walk has become a viral trend, and some impersonators are getting it remarkably right
articles.summary: His unusual walk has become a viral trend, and some impersonators are getting it remarkably right
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes has recently gone viral on social media because of his unusual way of walking. Videos and edits highlighting his straight posture and stiff-looking steps have taken over the internet, with several impersonators trying to recreate the Chiefs quarterback's signature walk. Surprisingly, many of them have nailed the impression.

But while people find his walking style funny, there are a few theories about why Mahomes moves this way, and one of them goes back to his early days as a professional athlete.

A habit that started on the baseball field

Before joining the NFL, Mahomes was a baseball pitcher . At the time, generating power through hip rotation was essential to his throwing motion. He had to rotate his body and drive force through his hips rather than relying only on his legs.

That movement pattern eventually followed him into football. It influenced not only his throwing mechanics but also gradually changed the way he walked. Instead of naturally bending his knees, M ahomes began relying more on his hips to move his body . Over time, that movement became an unconscious habit.

Another possible explanation is the history of knee injuries Mahomes has dealt with throughout his career. Those setbacks may have influenced the way he distributes his weight when walking, allowing him to rely less on his knees and spread the load across his body.

More than just a funny walk

These explanations remain theories surrounding Mahomes' unusual walking style. While many people see it as something funny or simply part of his personality, it could actually be the result of habits developed over years of playing sports.

That is also why impersonators have found such a recognizable detail to recreate. What started as an unusual movement has become one of the most recognizable things about the Chiefs quarterback on social media.

articles.title: Is Patrick Mahomes playing vs Falcons? Chiefs announce official injury status for star QB
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs have provided a crucial update on Patrick Mahomes' injury status ahead of their matchup against the Falcons.
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs have provided a crucial update on Patrick Mahomes' injury status ahead of their matchup against the Falcons.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs experienced some tense moments last week against the New York Jets when Patrick Mahomes had to leave the field briefly after taking a hard hit to the elbow of his throwing arm. The star quarterback showed discomfort and raised alarm within a team that had started the season 5-0 .

However, the concern eased with each update on his status. Mahomes returned to the game and did not miss any plays, while also leading the Chiefs to a victory that ended a two-game losing streak.

After the game, the two-time MVP acknowledged that at the start of the second half he had difficulty throwing with comfort and accuracy, although he explained that his feelings improved as the game progressed. The medical staff later conducted the corresponding tests.

The MRI on his elbow revealed no significant damage — positive news for Kansas City, especially after Mahomes admitted that any discomfort in that area causes concern because of how unpredictable it can be.

What is Patrick Mahomes’ current status?

This Wednesday, November 11 , the Chiefs confirmed that their quarterback participated as a full participant in practice ahead of the matchup against the Atlanta Falcons , a sign that he is on track to play in Sunday’s game. The team will look to improve its 6-2 record and continue competing in the AFC West , where it currently sits as the second-best team.

Adam Schefter of ESPN reported on X : “The Chiefs listed QB Patrick Mahomes as a full participant in today’s practice, putting him on track to play Sunday in Atlanta.”

Should there be concern? The real test will come when the star quarterback suits up and takes the field in a more demanding matchup. The Chiefs will look to prove they remain one of the NFL’s top contenders .

articles.title: The Chiefs accelerate the path toward their $3 billion stadium: this is what comes next
articles.standfirst: The project that will change the future of Kansas City continues to move forward. The NFL franchise confirmed the companies that will be in charge of building its new stadium, which will have a capacity of 70,000 spectators and will open its doors in 2031.
articles.summary: The project that will change the future of Kansas City continues to move forward. The NFL franchise confirmed the companies that will be in charge of building its new stadium, which will have a capacity of 70,000 spectators and will open its doors in 2031.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs took another step toward building their next stadium, a project valued at $3 billion that promises to transform the experience of their fans. The franchise announced the addition of Clark Construction Group and AECOM, two companies that will work together to carry out the project in Wyandotte County, Kansas.

The news also reignited a question among the team's followers: what will Patrick Mahomes' new home be like, and what will it have to maintain the atmosphere that made Arrowhead one of the NFL's most recognizable stadiums? Some of the features have already been previewed.

The Chiefs confirmed who will build their new stadium

Franchise president Mark Donovan welcomed the addition of the companies and emphasized that they share the team's vision for this project. "They understand our vision and have the necessary experience for a project of this magnitude", he noted.

Clark Construction Group and AECOM will work under a joint venture called Clark | AECOM. Their task will be to turn the initial design into a construction-ready project, with the necessary permits, budget, and planning. Meanwhile, the architects at MANICA and HNTB continue working on the seating layout, premium spaces, and the complex’s infrastructure.

Translucent roof, 20,000 parking spaces and capacity for 70,000 people

The first designs published by the Chiefs reveal some of the features the stadium will have. The venue will feature a fully enclosed and translucent roof, an approximate capacity for 70,000 spectators and more than 20,000 parking spaces.

Its exterior design will also feature references to Arrowhead. The structure will combine a curved façade with undulating upper levels in the end zone areas, a way to preserve visual elements of the team's historic home in its new location.

But there is something else the franchise wants to preserve: the atmosphere of its games. Clark Hunt assured that the design will take into account one of Arrowhead's most recognizable features. "The entire building will be built to generate noise", he stated. In addition, he promised that it will continue to be "the best place in the world for tailgating" , the traditional gathering of fans in the parking lots before the games.

Patrick Mahomes acknowledged what he will lose with the departure from Arrowhead

The move also represents an emotional change for Patrick Mahomes. In an interview with CNBC conducted in July 2025, before the Chiefs chose Kansas as the destination for their new stadium, the quarterback spoke about the bond he has with Arrowhead.

"Arrowhead is a special place. It is a special place that doesn’t come along very often. It is my favorite place to play in the NFL, not only because it is my team, but because you can feel its history when you play", he said.

Mahomes also acknowledged that he had no power to decide where the team would play. "Either way, I don't really have a choice in the matter", he said. However, he had positive words for the future in Kansas and trusted that the state would build a top-tier stadium and facilities.

When will the Chiefs' new stadium be ready?

The schedule sets initial site work to begin in 2027, while the opening is planned for the start of the NFL’s 2031 season. The complex will be located near The Legends and Kansas Speedway, in Kansas City, Kansas.

The stadium is part of a broader development involving a total investment of $4.5 billion . Within that plan, the venue represents an estimated investment of $3 billion , with up to $1.8 billion in public financing through STAR bonds approved by Kansas. The Hunt family also committed another $1 billion to the development in the state.

Until then, the Chiefs will continue playing at Arrowhead, their home since 1972. The new phase already has construction companies, a preliminary timeline, and some defined features, although there are still design details to be finalized.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce hit with CMA Awards drama before major NFL stretch
articles.standfirst: Fans have received some bad news regarding Taylor Swift's possible appearance at the Dolly Parton tribute at the CMA Awards.
articles.summary: Fans have received some bad news regarding Taylor Swift's possible appearance at the Dolly Parton tribute at the CMA Awards.
articles.body:
There is no doubt that Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are currently one of the most media-covered couples, so every move they make becomes tabloid news. Now, uncertainty surrounds the multi-Grammy winner’s role in the tribute to Dolly Parton at the 2026 CMA Awards .

The truth about Taylor Swift’s presence at the Dolly Parton tribute is revealed

Although Swift recently appeared at the sixth Academy Museum Gala , a source confirmed to E! News that the 14-time Grammy winner will not take part in the special tribute dedicated to Parton during the ceremony.

The news sparked disappointment among fans of both artists because of the deep admiration Swift has always expressed for the country legend.

After Parton’s passing, Swift dedicated an emotional message through The Hollywood Reporter in which she highlighted the impact of her legacy.

“A world without Dolly doesn’t feel possible, real, or right. But because of the eternally generous way she spent her time on this earth and the countless lives she changed for the better, her legacy will be an everlasting one.

“She was truly the gift that kept on giving. Dolly gave us someone to look up to while encouraging us to be who we are as individuals. Somehow she was able to give us her lessons about the world gently and honestly, simultaneously, and oftentimes hilariously.”

Travis Kelce's $3.5 million Ohio mansion gets the best news, but some neighbors are still upset: “It's a shame”

Will Travis Kelce accompany Taylor Swift to the CMA Awards?

One month before her wedding to Kelce, Swift released “I Knew It, I Knew You,” a song included on the soundtrack for Toy Story 5 . The track became a hit and marked the artist’s return to No. 1 on the country charts after 13 years .

The single also earned her a nomination for Single of the Year at the CMA Awards , her first nomination in four years. The last time Swift won an award at the ceremony was in 2017 with “Better Man,” which was named Song of the Year.

The 60th CMA Awards will take place on November 18 , and Swift has confirmed she will be in attendance.

The Kansas City Chiefs will face the Atlanta Falcons on November 15 and then host the Arizona Cardinals on November 22 in Week 11 of the NFL season.

Because Kansas City must return to practice on Wednesday after the Sunday game, all signs point to Travis Kelce being unable to accompany Taylor Swift in Nashville . As a result, the singer may have to attend the ceremony with another companion.

Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s connection to Dolly Parton

Before officially becoming spouses at Madison Square Garden on July 3 , Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift demonstrated their commitment to social causes by jointly donating $26 million to various charitable organizations.

Among the projects that received support was Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library, to which the couple contributed $2 million . The initiative, created by the iconic country singer in 1995 , aims to promote childhood literacy by sending free books to children. Parton passed away on August 25 at the age of 80 after a brief battle with cancer.

With the 2026 Country Music Association Awards approaching, speculation arose that Taylor Swift might participate in the tribute the ceremony is preparing to honor Dolly Parton. The account DeuxMoi fueled the rumors by posting that it was “hearing that Taylor Swift could be among the participating artists, ” though a new report has since ruled out that possibility.

articles.title: Pregnant Brittany Mahomes tries risky viral trend with her kids that that raises safety questions
articles.standfirst: Pregnant Brittany Mahomes’ latest family video has fans talking after a viral stunt with her kids raised unexpected safety concerns.
articles.summary: Pregnant Brittany Mahomes’ latest family video has fans talking after a viral stunt with her kids raised unexpected safety concerns.
articles.body:
B rittany Mahomes , who is pregnant with her and Patrick Mahomes ’ fourth child, joined a popular social media trend alongside her three children, but the lighthearted family moment quickly sparked debate among users who questioned the safety of the activity.

The 31-year-old co-owner of the Kansas City Current shared an Instagram video in which she participates in the so-called “spin trend” with Sterling , 5; Bronze , 3; and Golden , 1.

In the clip, the children are seen being spun while holding their mother’s phone to capture their reactions and laughter inside a gym. Although Brittany posted the video with humor and captioned it “Spin trend with our kids,” some followers pointed out that the activity could pose a risk, especially given the children’s ages and her pregnancy.

“We could not stop laughing,” the mother of three added when sharing the clip in her Instagram Stories.

Brittany and Patrick Mahomes announce another baby on the way

The video went viral as Brittany and her husband, Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes , celebrate the news that they are expecting their fourth child.

“Another blessing from God and now we’re 6,” Brittany wrote when announcing the pregnancy alongside family photos on the beach.

The couple are already parents to Sterling, Bronze, and Golden, who even took part in the announcement by placing their hands on Brittany’s belly to welcome the newest member of the family.

articles.title: Heated clash over Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s mansion ends with a savage divorce prediction
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's dream home became the center of a neighborhood battle.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's dream home became the center of a neighborhood battle.
articles.body:
T aylor Swift and Travis Kelce ’s mansion in Ohio has become the center of a neighborhood controversy after some residents questioned the couple’s proposed garden renovation plans.

During a community meeting in Bratenahl, one neighbor even stirred controversy by claiming that the marriage between the singer and the Kansas City Chiefs star will end in divorce within a decade.

The resident criticized the proposed modifications to the $5.35 million property and argued that the effort was unnecessary because, in his view, the house would likely be sold in a few years following an eventual separation.

“This effort that’s being put in for Taylor Swift, I think for a property that’s pretty much going to be a timeshare and sold in seven to 10 years when the divorce happens, I think it’s ridiculous,” he said, according to Page Six.

The man defended his remarks and said he was simply offering “a different opinion.”

The discussion also included complaints about the new shrubs and landscaping intended to give Swift and Kelce greater privacy. Some neighbors argued that the design would negatively affect the neighborhood’s appearance and even the local wildlife.

Other residents, however, came to the couple’s defense and suggested the community should feel fortunate that two high-profile figures chose Bratenahl as their home.

In the end, the Architectural Review Board unanimously approved the project, which includes new brickwork and shrubs that will reach up to 10 feet in height once fully grown. Swift and Kelce were not present at the meeting; their representatives presented the plans.

Travis Kelce’s historic mansion

The property purchased by Kelce has more than a century of history. The Chiefs player bought the waterfront estate for $5.35 million , returning to the area where he grew up alongside his brother Jason.

The residence, historically known as “Moyenage,” was built in 1904 in the Tudor style and spans approximately 21,140 square feet . It features eight bedrooms, seven fireplaces, a five-car garage, a heated pool, a gym, a sauna, and a wine cellar.

The renovation preserved the home’s historic elements while adding modern technology to transform it into a smart property.

First Christmas as husband and wife

Beyond the controversy, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are preparing to spend their first Christmas as a married couple.

Kelce revealed that he is excited to blend both of their family traditions and create new ones with the singer.

“I’m excited for my first Christmas as a married man,” the NFL player said.

Swift has also spoken on several occasions about her love for the holiday season, a tradition that began during her childhood on a Christmas tree farm in Pennsylvania .

articles.title: Andy Reid ignores fans criticizing struggling kicker Harrison Butker making Chiefs' future clear
articles.standfirst: Despite the growing frustration in Kansas City, Andy Reid is not ready to give up on his longtime kicker
articles.summary: Despite the growing frustration in Kansas City, Andy Reid is not ready to give up on his longtime kicker
articles.body:
H arrison Butker is facing increasing pressure after a difficult stretch that has raised questions about his place on the Chiefs roster. His latest struggles against the New York Jets on November 8 sparked another wave of criticism, particularly after he missed two consecutive field-goal attempts late in the first half. The reaction from the Arrowhead Stadium crowd made the situation even more uncomfortable for the veteran.

Through eight games, Butker has converted just 12 of his 19 field-goal attempts, giving him seven misses, the most of any kicker in the NFL this season. He has also failed to make at least one field goal in four straight games, leaving fans increasingly concerned about his reliability.

Andy Reid stands by Butker despite growing criticism

While supporters have voiced their frustration, Reid has made his position clear for the upcoming matchup . Chiefs head coach confirmed that Butker would remain the team's starting kicker for its road game against the Atlanta Falcons.

Reid acknowledged that the veteran has experienced a difficult period but pointed to his previous contributions to Kansas City as a reason to give him more time. He described the situation as a series of ups and downs and explained that he wants Butker to have the opportunity to work through his current problems before making another decision.

The coach's comments offer some reassurance for Butker, although they do not guarantee his long-term place on the roster. Reid indicated that the team would evaluate the situation as things develop, leaving room for further discussions after the upcoming game.

Justin Tucker's arrival adds another layer to the situation

The Chiefs' decision to bring in Justin Tucker has also increased the attention surrounding Butker's position . Kansas City signed the former Baltimore Ravens kicker to its practice squad on October 28, giving the organization another experienced option while Butker works to regain his form.

Tucker, a five-time first-team All-Pro, owns an 89.1% career field-goal conversion rate, the second-highest mark in NFL history. However, he has not played in an NFL game since the 2024 season. For now, R eid is choosing to stay with Butker , who has been part of all three of Kansas City's recent Super Bowl championship teams. ​ Butker has acknowledged that his recent results have not met expectations , but he remains confident in his ability to turn things around. His next opportunity will come against the Falcons on November 15 , when he will have a chance to respond to the criticism on the field.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes takes a moment for herself with a nostalgic millennial poof as a new chapter begins
articles.standfirst: Her longtime hairstylist, Laurabeth Cabott, shared the products behind the throwback look
articles.summary: Her longtime hairstylist, Laurabeth Cabott, shared the products behind the throwback look
articles.body:
A little volume, a little nostalgia and a look that takes Brittany Mahomes straight back to the 2000s. Hairstylist Laurabeth Cabott called it the “millennial poof,” a lifted, voluminous style that gives the familiar throwback a fresh finish.

The Instagram post is a beauty breakdown, not a statement from Brittany about motherhood or self-care. But it offers a relatable glimpse of the time and attention that go into feeling polished and like yourself, even when family life is full.

A millennial throwback and a moment that feels like her own

Brittany and Patrick Mahomes are parents to Sterling, Bronze and Golden , and announced on Nov. 10 that they are expecting their fourth child. They also have two dogs, Steel and Silver.

For many mothers, a moment in the glam chair can be more than getting ready for a photo. It can be a chance to enjoy a look, recognize yourself in the mirror and feel confident in your own skin.

She can be devoted to her family and still have moments that are hers.

Brittany’s family life often overlaps with football: she is married to Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes, and she has supported him through seasons when the team reached the Super Bowl.

There’s a fun pattern fans have noticed: the Chiefs made it to the big game during each of her first three pregnancies winning once and losing twice. Patrick has joked that he hopes the pattern continues, though the season is still underway.

The look also highlights the people behind it. Cabott, a Kansas City stylist and owner of Artistry by LB, has created other looks for Brittany. In this post, she credited makeup artist R. Partistry KC and stylist Margot Sykes, and tagged the brands behind the curling iron, root-lifting product, blowout cream, volume powder and strong-hold spray.

Cabott’s caption makes the inspiration clear: a familiar millennial-era hairstyle, refreshed for now. The result isn’t a dramatic transformation so much as a playful nod to a look many women remember and a reminder that personal style can be fun at any stage of life.

The Chiefs are scheduled to visit the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday, Nov. 15. Whether Brittany brings this nostalgic style to game day remains to be seen, but the refreshed look adds a bright, confident note as she prepares to welcome baby No. 4 and step into a new chapter with her growing family.
